text: MOKI 白板 for DSH 是供网页客户端使用的本地无限画布插件，在 DSH 右侧工作区和侧栏加入白板入口，并把白板工具接入对话。用户可以绘制便签与图形、创建和编辑思维导图、整理多页内容及素材，还能导入导出白板。选区可由用户主动加入当前对话草稿，供后续交流使用；数据保存在本机 DSH_HOME/whiteboard，无需单独配置 MCP。

MOKI Canvas for DSH adds a local canvas to the DSH web client. Its tools let DSH read, create, edit, and export boards and mind maps. Users can organize notes and media, then add selected content to a chat draft. Board data is stored locally; no separate MCP setup is needed.

I need an editable canvas inside DSH for notes, diagrams, and mind maps.
Can I share a selected part of my whiteboard with the current chat?
MOKI 白板的功能「多页无限画布」：在 DSH 右侧工作区打开画布，绘制和编辑白板内容，并通过多个页面组织项目。
MOKI 白板的功能「对话白板工具」：DSH 对话可调用白板工具读取、创建、修改和导出白板；工具按活动对话关联当前白板。
MOKI 白板的功能「思维导图编辑」：通过白板工具创建或修改思维导图节点与分支，支持批量建立多层节点并调整节点宽度。
MOKI 白板的功能「选区加入对话草稿」：在白板选中内容后点击输入框旁的加入对话控件，将选区文字及可用图片加入草稿，仍由用户发送。
MOKI 白板将数据库及附件保存在本机 DSH_HOME/whiteboard（未设置时为 ~/.dsh/whiteboard），嵌入服务绑定 127.0.0.1 的动态端口。

**A local-first canvas for thinking, creating, and working with DeepSeek Harness.**

dsh-moki-canvas README · MOKI Canvas for DSH：MOKI Canvas brings an editable infinite canvas into DSH's side workspace. Sketch an idea, grow it into a mind map, collect references, and keep notes, images, files, audio, and video together. The compact interface follows DSH's light or dark theme and leaves more room for your work.

dsh-moki-canvas README · MOKI Canvas for DSH：Work with DSH in both directions: let the agent read and edit your boards, or select something on the canvas and click **Add to chat** beside the composer. Your selection becomes a text reference and an image attachment in the current draft. You decide when to send it. A six-page, fully editable introduction board lets you explore the tools through a playful camping-film project.

dsh-moki-canvas README · See it in action：These are real, dark-theme DSH interface captures from a separate demo profile containing only the bundled introduction. The sidebar entry, conversation composer and side workspace stay visible, so you can see how the plugin works inside DSH. No personal boards, accounts, chat history, or local paths are included. The visible prompts are unsent demonstration drafts.

**1. Open a canvas beside your conversation.**

dsh-moki-canvas README · See it in action：**2. Select content on the right. A selection hint appears beside the DSH composer.**

**3. Click Add to chat. The text reference and screenshot join your draft; your typed request is preserved.**

**4. Edit the canvas directly, or prepare a request for DSH. Here, a mind-map node is selected and its width is adjusted.**

dsh-moki-canvas README · What you can do：- **Draw and arrange:** sticky notes, text, shapes, arrows, freehand strokes, Bézier paths, alignment, grouping, zoom, and a minimap.
- **Build real mind maps:** edit node text and width, drag branches, collapse or expand them, and add nodes with Tab or Enter. DSH can add up to 200 nodes in one batch while preserving hierarchy.
- **Keep references nearby:** add images, files, links, audio, and video; search, locate, rename, and preview items from the page's materials list.
- **Organize a project:** multiple pages and page groups, editable boards, version history, `.moki` import/export, and image export.
- **Collaborate with DSH:** canvas tools register automatically. Ask the agent to inspect, create, update, arrange, or export content without setting up a separate MCP server.
- **Share a selection deliberately:** a composer hint previews the active selection; clicking adds its text and screenshot to the draft, preserving what you have typed. It does not send a message automatically.
- **Learn by editing:** the bundled introduction contains six pages, native mind-map nodes, an expandable materials group, and small offline media examples.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Supported imports：Drop files onto the canvas, paste images or URLs, or add materials from the toolbar. The following describes importing and previewing in **DSH plugin v1.5.1**:

dsh-moki-canvas README · Supported imports：| Type | Formats | Behavior in the canvas |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Images | PNG, JPG / JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, SVG | Place, move, resize, and view images on the canvas |
| Video | MP4, WebM, M4V, MOV, OGV, MKV, AVI | Recognized as video cards; playback depends on DSH's embedded browser and the file's codecs |
| Audio | MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OGA, Opus, FLAC | Drop as audio cards; playback also depends on browser codec support |
| PDF | `.pdf` | Stored as file cards, with paginated previews in the materials dialog |
| Text and code | `.txt`, `.md`, `.markdown`, `.json`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.log`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.xml`, `.css`, `.js`, `.ts`, `.py` | Plain-text preview in the materials dialog, up to 5 MB |
| Office and other attachments | DOC / DOCX, XLS / XLSX, PPT / PPTX, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, and other files | Stored as file cards; use Open to access the original file. These formats currently have no inline preview in the DSH materials dialog |
| Web and image links | HTTP / HTTPS URLs and direct image URLs | Paste as link cards or images; embedded web previews depend on the destination site's embedding policy |
| MOKI board files | `.moki`, `

dsh-moki-canvas README · Supported imports：Markdown, JSON, CSV, and TSV files are shown as source text in the current DSH materials dialog. Ordinary `.json` files are text attachments; MOKI board documents use the dedicated board importer.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Install：Tested with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 on Windows x64**. Other operating systems and DSH versions have not been verified for this release. The canvas UI and built-in tour are primarily Chinese; the plugin's DSH entry and selection controls also provide English labels.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Install by chat：Open a DSH conversation with plugin management available. Copy the entire prompt below into the composer and send it:

```text
Please install and enable MOKI Canvas for DSH v1.5.1.

Project: https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-canvas-for-dsh
Read the project's installation instructions, then use plugin_manager in the current DSH environment:

dsh-moki-canvas README · Install by chat：This uses the plugin manager in your current DSH environment. If the tool is unavailable, use a preset with plugin management enabled, such as Creator, or enter the same package URL on the sidebar's Plugins page. Check the reported version, enabled state, and any restart instruction. See the [DSH plugin-manager reference](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/boot/plugin-manager/README.md).

dsh-moki-canvas README · Manual installation：1. Download `dsh-moki-canvas-1.5.1.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-canvas-for-dsh/releases/tag/v1.5.1).
2. For Desktop, use **Manage dsh Command…** in the application menu to install or repair the bundled command. Open a new terminal and run `dsh --version` to confirm it matches Desktop. Then fully quit DSH from its application or tray menu; closing the window may leave it running.
3. In the directory containing the downloaded package, run:

dsh-moki-canvas README · Manual installation：```sh
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-moki-canvas-1.5.1.tgz
   dsh plugin --profile desktop list dsh-moki-canvas --depth 0
   ```

4. Reopen DSH. Open **MOKI Canvas / MOKI 白板** from the left sidebar, or add it as a tab in the right workspace. Open a chat to use selection-to-draft collaboration.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Manual installation：Manage the `desktop` profile with Desktop's bundled CLI; a separately npm-installed `dsh` cannot manage that profile. For Web or a custom profile, replace `desktop` with its actual name and use the same `DSH_HOME` as your running DSH. See the [Desktop command reference](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime).

dsh-moki-canvas README · Manual installation：The release contains the built application and host bundle. You do not need the MOKI source repository or a separate MOKI desktop app. DSH downloads the declared runtime dependencies during installation. See the [official packaging and installation guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish).

dsh-moki-canvas README · Manual installation：If you previously installed the development package `@local/dsh-moki-whiteboard`, remove that plugin before adding `dsh-moki-canvas`, so that only one copy runs. Both use the same default board-data directory; removing the plugin package does not delete that directory.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Try it：Open **MOKI 白板简介 · for DSH**, choose a page from the upper-left menu, and press **Ctrl+0** to fit the page. Duplicate the guide before experimenting if you want to keep a reference copy.

On page 5, select a task card and click **Add to chat / 加入对话**. Then ask, for example:

> Read the selected notes and turn them into a three-step shooting plan. Update only the selected content.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Try it：> Create a two-sided mind map for a weekend camping film. Use wider nodes for long text, and add the preparation tasks in one batch.

The introduction is initialized once per data directory. Your edits survive restarts, and deleting it does not cause it to reappear.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Data and collaboration：Boards and attachments live in `$DSH_HOME/whiteboard`, or `~/.dsh/whiteboard` when `DSH_HOME` is unset. The embedded service listens on `127.0.0.1` at an automatically assigned port. LAN sharing starts disabled for a new data directory; existing preferences are preserved.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Data and collaboration：Active canvas context and selection are scoped to the current DSH chat. Tools with an explicit board ID can also access other boards in the same local library. Edits support version checks to prevent stale writes. Content added to a chat is sent through your configured DSH model/provider when you submit the message.

This is a community plugin built on [MOKI 白板](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-whiteboard). It is not an official DeepSeek product.

dsh-moki-canvas README · Develop：The repository includes the exact canvas source snapshot in `vendor/moki`, the plugin source, and prebuilt runtime files. Use Node.js 22.13 or later.

```sh
npm ci
npm ci --prefix vendor/moki --ignore-scripts
npm run typecheck
npm run build

dsh-moki-canvas README · Develop：`src/host.js` starts the embedded canvas server and adapts its tools to DSH. `client.js` provides workspace tabs, sidebar access, theme synchronization, and selection-to-draft controls. `src/builtin-intro.js` initializes the editable guide without replacing user edits. `scripts/build.mjs` builds against `vendor/moki` by default; `MOKI_REPO` can point to another compatible checkout.

**一张和 DSH 一起思考、整理与创作的本地画布。**

MOKI 白板 for DSH（英文名 **MOKI Canvas for DSH**）将可编辑的无限画布带进 DeepSeek Harness 侧边工作区。你可以随手画下想法，将它展开成思维导图，把便签、图片、文件、链接、音视频放在同一处，逐步整理成完整项目。紧凑界面跟随 DSH 的深浅色主题，让画布保留更多空间。

白板与对话可以双向协作：让 DSH 读取、创建和修改画布，或选中画布内容，点击输入框旁的“加入对话”，将文字引用和选区截图放进当前草稿，再由你决定何时发送。插件内置六页可编辑的“星空露营短片”简介，用真实的白板工具带你边玩边学。

dsh-moki-canvas README · 界面预览：以下均为独立演示环境中的 DSH 暗调主界面实拍。左侧白板入口、对话输入框和右侧工作区同时保留，展示插件在 DSH 中的状态与交互方式。只使用内置示例，不包含个人白板、账号、聊天记录和本机路径；输入框中的文字是未发送的演示草稿。

**1. 从左侧入口打开白板，与对话并排工作。**

**2. 在右侧选中内容，DSH 输入框旁出现选区提示。**

**3. 点击“加入对话”，文字引用和截图进入草稿，已经输入的要求继续保留。**

**4. 直接编辑白板，也可以准备一条 DSH 请求。这里选中了脑图节点，并调整了节点宽度。**

dsh-moki-canvas README · 主要能力：- **画出想法：**便签、文字、图形、箭头、自由绘图、贝塞尔曲线、对齐、分组、缩放和缩略导航。
- **让想法长成树：**原生思维导图支持节点宽度、文字换行、分支拖动、折叠展开，以及 Tab / Enter 添加节点；DSH 可一次批量添加最多 200 个节点并保留层级。
- **把素材放在手边：**加入图片、文件、链接、音视频，通过当前页面素材列表搜索、定位、重命名和预览。
- **整理整个项目：**多页面与页面分组、版本历史、`.moki` 导入导出、图片导出，让内容持续可编辑。
- **让 DSH 参与：**工具和活动白板上下文自动接入，可通过对话读取、创建、修改、排版和导出，无需单独配置 MCP。
- **选中后加入对话：**点击输入框旁的选区提示，将文字与截图加入草稿，保留已输入内容；不会自动发送消息。
- **在介绍里直接试：**六页内置简介包含可编辑对象、真实脑图节点、可展开的素材分组，以及可离线使用的小型图片、音频和视频示例。

dsh-moki-canvas README · 支持置入的格式：| 类型 | 格式 | 在白板中的使用方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 图片 | PNG、JPG / JPEG、WebP、GIF、AVIF、BMP、SVG | 作为图片置入画布，可移动、缩放和查看 |
| 视频 | MP4、WebM、M4V、MOV、OGV、MKV、AVI | 识别为视频卡片；播放能力取决于 DSH 内置浏览器和文件编码 |
| 音频 | MP3、WAV、M4A、AAC、OGG、OGA、Opus、FLAC | 拖入后作为音频卡片播放；同样受浏览器解码能力限制 |
| PDF | `.pdf` | 作为文件卡片保存，在素材窗口分页预览 |
| 文本与代码 | `.txt`、`.md`、`.markdown`、`.json`、`.csv`、`.tsv`、`.log`、`.yaml`、`.yml`、`.xml`、`.css`、`.js`、`.ts`、`.py` | 在素材窗口按文本预览；文本预览上限为 5 MB |
| Office 与其他附件 | DOC / DOCX、XLS / XLSX、PPT / PPTX、ZIP、RAR、7Z 等文件 | 以文件卡片置入和保存，通过“打开”访问原文件；当前 DSH 素材窗口不提供这些格式的内嵌预览 |
| 网页与图片链接 | HTTP / HTTPS 网址、图片直链 | 粘贴生成链接卡片或置入图片；网页预览取决于目标网站是否允许嵌入 |
| MOKI 白板文件 | `.moki`、`.moki-board`、`.moki.json`、`.moki-board.json` | 通过“打开白板文件”或拖入导入，恢复可继续编辑的白板内容 |
dsh-moki-canvas README · 支持置入的格式：Markdown、JSON、CSV 和 TSV 文件在当前 DSH 素材窗口中按原文展示。普通 `.json` 属于文本附件；带 MOKI 格式的白板文件使用专用导入流程。
dsh-moki-canvas README · 安装：本版实测环境为 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 / Windows x64**。其他系统和 DSH 版本尚未验证。画布和内置导览目前以中文为主；插件入口与选区协同控件提供中英文文案。

dsh-moki-canvas README · 手动安装：桌面版的 `desktop` profile 应由桌面版自带 CLI 管理；通过 npm 安装的另一份 `dsh` 不能替代它。Web 或自定义 profile 请将命令中的 `desktop` 替换为实际名称，并保持与当前 DSH 相同的 `DSH_HOME`。参见 [桌面版命令说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime)。

安装包已包含画布和宿主构建结果，无需下载 MOKI 源码或另装白板桌面客户端；安装时由 DSH 获取声明的运行依赖。安装机制见 [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish)。
dsh-moki-canvas README · 手动安装：如果此前安装过开发包 `@local/dsh-moki-whiteboard`，请先移除该插件，再安装 `dsh-moki-canvas`，避免同时运行两份。两者使用相同的默认白板数据目录；卸载插件包不会删除该数据目录。

dsh-moki-canvas README · 快速体验：打开 **MOKI 白板简介 · for DSH**，用左上角菜单切换页面，按 **Ctrl+0** 适应整页。建议先复制简介，再自由尝试编辑。

在第 5 页选中一张任务卡，点击输入框旁的 **加入对话**，然后试着说：

> 读取我选中的便签，把它整理成三步拍摄计划，只修改选中的内容。

> 创建一张双向布局的周末露营短片思维导图，长文字使用更宽的节点，一次添加准备事项及子节点。

简介每个数据目录只初始化一次。重启不会覆盖修改，删除后也不会反复出现。

dsh-moki-canvas README · 数据与协同：白板和附件保存在 `$DSH_HOME/whiteboard`，未设置时使用 `~/.dsh/whiteboard`。内置服务监听 `127.0.0.1` 的动态端口。新数据目录默认关闭局域网分享，已有分享偏好会保留。

活动白板与选区按 DSH 对话隔离；明确指定白板 ID 的工具仍可访问同一本地库中的其他白板。修改支持版本校验，避免过期写入。加入草稿的内容会在你发送消息时，通过 DSH 配置的模型或服务商处理。

本项目基于 [MOKI 白板](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-whiteboard)，是社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。
